✦ Capabilities

Everything You Need to Manage Your Fleet

From real-time telemetry to AI-powered predictions, TruckPulse gives you complete visibility and control over every vehicle.

📡

Live Telemetry

Real-time OBD-II data pipeline — RPM, temperature, voltage, vibration, speed, engine load, and fuel efficiency streamed live from every truck.

🧠

AI Health Engine

Multi-parameter weighted analysis with trend detection, sustained-condition penalties, and catastrophic-pattern recognition built in.

🗺️

Fleet Map

Interactive OpenStreetMap showing every truck's live position, route trail, and status — click any marker to inspect that vehicle.

🔔

Smart Alerts

Tiered alerts with hysteresis — dashboard banners, toast notifications, WhatsApp-style previews, and audio tones for critical events.

📊

Analytics Dashboard

Fleet-wide stats, vehicle comparison tables, fuel consumption tracking, maintenance predictions, and CSV report export.

🔧

Simulation Engine

7 realistic fault scenarios — overheating, low voltage, high vibration, engine instability, critical failure, and recovery — all with smooth physics.

⟐ Pipeline

Vehicle Data
